args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. Verified the rollback — the service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: INC-0001 ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the failure is root-caused, since it has never been healthy in production (which would also require change-manager approval).
